datum: V. O Lord, open Thou my lips.
R. And my mouth shall show forth Thy praise.
O come, let us sing unto the Lord, let us make a joyful noise to the God of our Salvation: let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto Him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods: for the Lord will not cast off His people: for in His hand are all the ends of the earth; and the heights of the hills are His also.

For the sea is His, and He made it: and His hands formed the dry land: O come, let us worship and fall down; let us cry unto the Lord our Maker. For He is the Lord our God; and we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
To-day if ye will hear His voice, harden not your heart; as in in the Provocation, and as in the day of Temptation in the wilderness: when your fathers tempted Me, proved Me, and saw My works.

Forty years long was I grieved with that generation and said, It is a people that do alway err in their heart, and they have not known My ways: unto whom I sware in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Let us worship the Lord. * For He is our maker.
Let it not be vain for you to rise up early, before the light: * For the Lord hath promised a crown to them that watch.
To-day if ye will hear the voice of the Lord: * Harden not your hearts.
The Lord is risen indeed: * Alleluia.
Serve the Lord * with fear, and rejoice with trembling before Him.
Behold, there cometh the King, * even the Most High, with great power, to save the nations, Alleluia.
Alleluia, * the stone was rolled away, Alleluia, from the door of the sepulchre, Alleluia, alleluia.
God is a righteous judge, * strong, and patient: is He not provoked every day?
Strengthen ye * the weak hands: be strong; say: Behold, our God will come, and save us, Alleluia.
Thou, O Lord, * shalt keep us, and preserve us.
Rejoice, all ye, * and be glad: for, behold, the Lord will come with vengeance, He will bring a recompense: He will come and save us.
V. I have remembered Thy name, O Lord, in the night.
R. And have kept Thy law.
V. Out of Zion, the Perfection of beauty.
R. Our God shall come manifestly.
V. He hath delivered me from the snare of the fowler.
R. And from the noisome pestilence.
V. O God, deliver my soul from the sword.
R. And my darling from the power of the dog.
V. The Lord is risen from the grave, Alleluia.
R. Who hung for us upon the tree, Alleluia.
Of my goods, * Thou hast no need; in Thee do I put my trust, preserve me, O Lord.
Rejoice greatly, * O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh into thee, O Zion; fear not, for thy salvation cometh quickly.
Alleluia, * woman, whom seekest thou? Alleluia, the Living among the dead? Alleluia, alleluia.
By the words * of Thy lips I have kept me to strait paths.
Our King * Christ cometh, Whom John preached, saying; Behold the Lamb That should come!
I will love Thee, * O Lord, my strength.
Behold, I come * quickly, saith the Lord, and My reward is with Me, to give every man according to his work shall be.
V. For Thou lightest my candle, O Lord.
R. My God, enlighten my darkness.
V. Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, the ruler of the land.
R. From the Rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
V. He shall cover thee with His wings.
R. And under His feathers shalt thou trust.
V. O Lord, save me from the lion's mouth.
R. And mine affliction from the horns of the unicorns.
V. The Lord is risen indeed, Alleluia.
R. And hath appeared unto Simon, Alleluia.
There is no speech * nor language where their voice is not heard.
The Angel Gabriel * spake unto Mary, saying: Hail, thou that art full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
Alleluia, * Weep not, Mary, Alleluia: the Lord is risen, Alleluia, alleluia.
The Lord hear thee * in the day of trouble
Mary said: * What manner of salutation is this? My soul is troubled. Shall I bear the King? And will He not break the seal of my virginity?
O Lord, * the king shall joy in Thy strength.
In the coming * of the King, the Most High, let the hearts of men be purified to go forth to meet Him, for, behold, He will come and will not tarry.
V. Be Thou exalted, O Lord, in Thine own strength.
R. We will sing and praise Thy power.
V. The Lord cometh out of His holy place.
R. He will come and save His people.
V. His truth shall be thy shield.
R. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night.
V. Take not away my soul with sinners, O God!
R. Nor my life with bloody men.
V. The disciples were glad, Alleluia.
R. When they saw the Lord, Alleluia.

responsum-i: Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord God of hosts:
responsum-ii: The whole earth is full of His glory.
versus: There are Three That bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these Three are One.

datum: We praise Thee, O God: * we acknowledge Thee to be the Lord.
All the earth doth worship Thee, * the Father everlasting.
To Thee all Angels cry aloud, * the heavens, and all the Powers therein.
To Thee Cherubim and Seraphim * continually do cry:
Holy, * Holy, * Holy, * Lord God of Sabaoth.
Heaven and earth are full * of the majesty of Thy glory.
The glorious company of the Apostles * praise Thee:
The goodly fellowship of the Prophets * praise Thee:
The white-robed army of Martyrs * praise Thee:
The holy Church throughout all the world * doth acknowledge Thee:
The Father * of an infinite Majesty:
Thine honurable, true, * and only Son:
Also the Holy Ghost, * the Comforter.
Thou art the King of glory, * O Christ!
Thou art the everlasting Son * of the Father.
When Thou tookest upon thee to deliver man, * Thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb:
When Thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death, * Thou didst open the kingdom of heaven to all believers:
Thou sittest at the right hand of God, * in the glory of the Father:
We believe that Thou shalt come * to be our Judge:
We therefore pray Thee, help Thy servants, * whom Thou hast redeemed with Thy precious Blood.
Make them to be numbered with Thy Saints * in glory everlasting.
O Lord, save Thy people, * and bless Thine inheritance.
Govern them, * and lift them up for ever.
Day by day * we magnify Thee;
And we worship Thy name, * ever world without end.
Vouchsafe, O Lord, this day, * to keep us without sin.
Have mercy upon us, O Lord, * have mercy on us.
O Lord, let Thy mercy lighten upon us, * as our trust is in Thee.
O Lord, in Thee have I trusted: * let me never be confounded.
Alleluia, alleluia, * Alleluia.

antiphona-invitatorium: O come, * Let us sing unto the Lord.
antiphona-i: The Lord is the defence * of my life.
antiphona-ii: Worship * the Lord in His holy courts.
antiphona-iv: For the unrighteous is deserved, * praise.
antiphona-v: Fight against them * that fight against me.
antiphona-vi: Show * thy way unto the Lord.

datum: V. Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens.
R. And thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

antiphona-invitatorium: Let us make a joyful noise to * The God of our salvation.
antiphona-i: That I sin not * with my tongue.
antiphona-ii: Heal * my soul, O Lord, for I have sinned against Thee.
antiphona-iii: Mine heart is overflowing * with a good matter.
antiphona-v: Great is the Lord, * and greatly to be praised.
antiphona-vi: The God of gods, * even the Lord, hath spoken.

datum: V. Offer unto God the sacrifice of praise.
R. And pay thy vows unto the Most High.

antiphona-invitatorium: In Thy hand, O Lord, * are the inmost depths of the earth.
antiphona-i: God bringeth back * the captivity of His people.
antiphona-ii: Because * my soul trusteth in Thee.
antiphona-iii: Judge uprightly, * O ye sons of men.
antiphona-iv: Give us * help from trouble, O Lord.
antiphona-v: Upon God, doth not * my soul wait?
antiphona-vi: O bless * our God, ye people.

datum: V. O God, I have declared my life unto Thee.
R. Thou hast put my tears in Thy sight.

antiphona-invitatorium: It is the Lord That hath made us: * O come, let us worship Him.
antiphona-i: O Lord God, * make haste to deliver me.
antiphona-ii: Be Thou to me * my God, my protector.
antiphona-iii: Thou hast redeemed the rod * of Thine inheritance.
antiphona-iv: And we will call * upon Thy name, O Lord.
antiphona-v: Thou art the God * That doest wonders.
antiphona-vi: Be merciful * unto our sins, O Lord.

datum: V. My lips shall be fain when I sing unto Thee.
R. And my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.

antiphona-invitatorium: Let us worship the Lord, * For He is our Maker.
antiphona-i: Sing aloud * unto God our strength.
antiphona-ii: Thou alone * art the Most High over all the earth.
antiphona-iii: Thou hast been favourable, * O Lord, unto Thy land.
antiphona-iv: Her foundation * is in the holy mountains.
antiphona-v: Blessed * be the Lord for evermore.
antiphona-vi: Sing * unto the Lord, and bless His name.

datum: V. Let my prayer come before Thee, O Lord.
R. Incline Thine ear unto my cry.

antiphona-invitatorium: O come, let us worship * The Lord our God.
antiphona-i: For marvellous things * hath the Lord done.
antiphona-ii: Make a joyful noise * unto God, all ye lands.

datum: It is good * to praise to the Lord.

antiphona-iii: Let my cry * come unto Thee, O God.
antiphona-iv: Bless * the Lord, O my soul!
antiphona-v: Visit us * with Thy salvation, O Lord.
antiphona-vi: I will praise the Lord * greatly with my mouth.
